title: Lisbon Market Research Summary
body_markdown:
The Lisbon metropolitan area has roughly 2.8 million residents and a fast-growing e-commerce segment, making it the strongest first market for Project Atlas.
## Findings
- E-commerce parcel volume in Portugal grew about 18 percent year over year in the reference study.
- Most regional retailers rely on two or three national carriers and report slow same-day options.
- Cold-chain delivery for groceries is underserved in the Lisbon area.
## Implication for Project Atlas
A same-day and cold-chain offering from the Lisbon hub gives Northwind Logistics a clear entry wedge.
